senses.gloss: a tool for planing wood &c. (so named from the grooves in which it runs), chisel, differ. fr. מְגֵירָה.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 2:2">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. II, 2</cite>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 11:15">Tosef. B. Kam. XI, 15</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 119b:17">B. Kam. 119ᵇ</cite> <he>היוצא … ומתחת הר׳ וכ׳</he> chips falling from under the borer and the chisel belong to the carpenter.

senses.gloss: (cmp. ξυστήρ a. ξύριον) a tool for shaving hair, an instrument with which the hairs are removed singly, differ. fr. תַּעַר.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Makkot 3:5">Macc. III, 5</cite>; <cite ref="Nazir 40b">Naz. 40ᵇ</cite>; a. e.
